__meta__.supersedes: rtx5090_power_by_model.json (2026-07-10) was an AD-HOC run: no script in the repo, no recorded method, no clean-card gate, and a recorded idle of 64.97 W. [image_gen] confirmed 2026-07-12 that its two resident ComfyUI processes held the idle floor at 61 W, falling to 21 W once stopped — so 64.97 W IS THE IDLE FLOOR OF A DIRTY CARD. The old per-model watts carry a tenant's baseline, which INFLATES the 5090's power and OVERSTATES the Orin's perf/W advantage.
__meta__.gate: Refuses to run unless the GPU has NO other compute process and idle median <= 35.0 W. Rows are INVALID unless power rises >= 25.0 W over idle and no tenant appears mid-run.
__meta__.method: nvidia-smi power.draw @ 100 ms. Engine PRELOADED (build excluded); 30s sustained execute_async_v3, first 6s discarded (boost transient); median of the steady window. Engine build/run imported from bench_corpus_trt_py.py — the same path that produced the published latencies.
__meta__.power_basis: WHOLE-BOARD (GPU die + GDDR7 + VRM) via nvidia-smi. NOT comparable to the Orin's die-only tegrastats SoC rails without the bracketing conventions in merge_power_perfw.py.
__meta__.card_state: EXCLUSIVE — image_gen released both ComfyUI processes at 09:13
__meta__.why_three_runs: The FIRST clean run and the SECOND disagreed by up to 16% on the same models on the same card. A single-shot replacement number would have been no more EARNED than the dirty one it replaced — just newer. Power on this card is genuinely noisy (spread 0.4%-17% by model), so every row is a median of 3 independent runs and the spread is published beside it. Conclusions are only drawn where they survive the 5090's MOST FAVOURABLE reading.
__meta__.guard_bug_found_and_fixed: The first version of the contention guard counted OUR OWN CUDA context as a foreign tenant and marked all 7 rows INVALID against perfectly good data — a guard firing on its own reflection. Fixed (own PID excluded). Recording it because a guard that manufactures a false accusation is worse than no guard: it looks like a finding.
